description:
WHEN: Use when your user asks what Dantes rates a NAMED stock, why, or for the analyst’s written report — "what does Dantes say about WING", "is NVDA a Strong Buy", "read me the Dantes report on PRLB". Up to 20 names; the written report is inlined for up to 3 names at a time.

NOT for: Do not use it to rate a market or a screen’s survivors wholesale — Dantes grades only names that reached a desk through a setup, so most names are blank; a blank is UNRATED, never Hold. It is not Street consensus (that is analyst-actions) and it is not investment advice.

Returns: { ok, rows: [{ symbol, grade, as_of, rated_at, written_as, confidence, setup, capability, report_page, essay | essay_note | why_blank }] } — grade is one of Strong Buy, Buy, Speculative, Hold, Trim, Sell or null; "Buy or better" means the first two only.
name: get_dantes_rating
title: Get the Dantes grade and analyst report for named symbols
